# Requirements

> Status: **Approved** · Updated: 2026-10-05 · DOC-01
> Depends on: original SDD §3

### FR-01 · Hold a seat

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criteria | Priority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FR-01.1 | A customer holds one free seat | Given seat A-12 is free, when the customer clicks it, then it is held for 10 minutes | Must |
| FR-01.2 | Two customers never hold the same seat | Given 2 concurrent holds on A-12, then exactly 1 succeeds | Must |
